get.description: The text extracted from the resource's content with where each run of it is on a page, as the Smelter stored it under the content's checksum: what the gateway serves at its own `GET /resources/{id}/anchored-text`. The answer is always one of the members of `AnchoredTextAnswer`, and `kind` says which: the text, a stored decline, or why there is none. With no entry stored, the Archivist waits for the Smelter to say it has settled that content (`smelt:settled`) before it answers; docs/protocol/ARCHIVIST.md says how long. A resource the record does not hold, and one whose content has no checksum, is answered `unknown`. It never runs an extractor.

200.description: The anchored text, a stored decline, or why there is none.
